not_found: Acquisition / selling expenses, general and administrative expenses, and profit for the investment-contract activity: not printed. IDI reports one segment "life insurance and long-term savings" (no investment-contract split of expenses or profit), so no such facts are given.

Liabilities for yield-dependent investment contracts alone are not printed in this interim report (IFRS 4 basis); only the combined insurance + investment contracts line is, given as yield_dependent_insurance_and_investment_liabilities. Restated IFRS 4 investment-contract-only balances for 30.6.24 and 30.9.24 appear in the 2025Q2 / 2025Q3 reports.
Fixed management fees on investment contracts alone are not printed in this interim report (the "דמי ניהול קבועים" row covers all savings policies).
New-business and one-time premiums for investment contracts: not printed in this interim report.
notes: Source entity: IDI Insurance Company Ltd (MAYA reporter id 1608, security 1129501), the insurer itself, not the Direct Insurance Financial Investments holding (MAYA 1089, bond issuer only). Reported in NIS thousands.
